target_customer: Offices that want snacks and drinks for employees without vending machines
problem: Office vending machines are expensive hardware with limited selection; Yumbin replaced them with software for self checkout markets.
business_model: Office snack market operator with software self checkout; product margin per sale
product_category: Office micro market and self checkout retail

founders.name: Kevin Tom
founders.background_notes: Only founder on the YC page, which gives no bio.

technical_complexity.rationale: Mobile point of sale checkout is standard software; operations and restocking were the harder parts.

defensibility.rationale: No proprietary technology or exclusive contracts found; micro market operators could copy the model.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent response; micro markets were already sold by established vendors but no dated source was found for 2014.

market_need_then: The YC description positions it against vending hardware; no dated demand evidence beyond that was found.

branding.domain_note: Used yumbin.com, which now redirects to a GoDaddy for-sale page.

identity.voice_and_tone: Playful food theme implied by the name Yumbin; no copy was found.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community about the brand found; the only brand record is a USPTO trademark for YUMBIN filed July 2014 by Depanneur, Inc., now marked dead.

outcome_analysis: Yumbin was a one founder YC Winter 2014 company that replaced office vending with self checkout snack markets and left no independent press, funding record or post-mortem. A trademark filed in July 2014 by Depanneur, Inc. is marked dead and the domain is now for sale. The cause of the shutdown is not public, so no failure factors are assigned.
notes: A Round Funded batch page may list Yumbin as Acquired but the layout was ambiguous and it is not confirmed; YC status is Inactive. Competitor search found only generic micro market vendors (365 Retail Markets, Avanti Markets) with no source dated near 2014, so the list is left empty. Round Funded describes its own text as a reconstruction and is not used for facts. Education and prior employers not found.
